notice: SIMULATED energy budget using datasheet values and explicit assumptions. Currents, regulator efficiency and duty profile are not measured. No usable battery capacity is configured, so runtime is not calculated. The candidate cell's rated capacity endpoint is not demonstrated usable with the 3.3 V buck rail as drawn. RX window matches firmware's 100 ms timeout; event bursts are bounded.

battery_candidate.capacity_rating_condition: datasheet rating at 1 mA to 2.0 V; not demonstrated usable with 3.3 V buck rail

mcu_stop.basis: STM32L031 STOP current 0.35 uA (datasheet typical, operating conditions matter)

mcu_run.basis: 76 uA/MHz x configured 4 MHz; application-dependent peripheral/clock load omitted

imu_low_power.basis: Configured estimate 0.8 uA; LIS2DW12 product summary states active low-power below 1 uA

radio_sleep.basis: Board-level sleep allowance, including radio/module leakage; not asserted as a validated SX1262 value

radio_tx.basis: Stress budget uses Semtech's published 45 mA at +14 dBm even though firmware configures +10 dBm; this is not an estimate of +10 dBm current.

radio_rx.basis: SX1262 active receive current from Semtech product information

ngspice_pulse_model.note: Use hardware/spice/candidate for the selected cell and regulator sweep. This simple pulse deck remains illustrative and the 2.7 V line is an assumed design rail threshold, not the MCU's physical brownout setting.
